chitchat: meows at you, then at the kitchen, then at you again.
rolls onto his side and watches you upside down.
headbutts your shin and keeps walking.
purrs before you've even touched him.
sits on the one thing you were about to pick up.
description: A big black-and-white tom, fat and fluffy. Black over his back and hind legs, white chest and front paws, a black ear on the left and a moustache under his nose. He looks like he owns the place, and he more or less does.
name: Scrappy
